_source: Measured on an RTX Spark on 2026-10-17 (read-only probe): GPU carve-out 98,240 MiB, 30.49 GiB visible to Windows, commit limit 126.49 GiB, a fixed 98,304 MB page file on C: with automatic management off, no .wslconfig, 26.9 GB (25.05 GiB) free on C: after the GPU route probe, Docker Desktop's data disk present. CommittedGiB is the 12 GiB measured at idle; WslNowGiB and RunningModelGiB are fixture values.
